title: Use after free in FileSystem in Google Chrome prior to 156.0.8078.79 allowed a remote attacker to execute arbitrary…
description: A use-after-free vulnerability exists in the FileSystem component of Google Chrome versions prior to 156.0.8078.79. This flaw allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code within the sandbox by delivering a specially crafted HTML page. The vulnerability is rated with high severity by Chromium security.
